positive_triggers: A selected effort contains several dependent or partially visible decision surfaces and resolving one is expected to expose others
Durable decision-map state must persist across multiple work cycles
An existing wayfinder map should be resumed (a ticket worked, fog graduated, drift repaired)
The Loop Router hands off a fog-heavy multi-surface effort
An uncertainty record (open-questions.md, uncertainty ledger, expanded-grill leftover) should seed a charted map
negative_triggers: An effort one bounded design interview can resolve (route to /expanded-grill-with-docs)
Work that fits direct execution in a single bounded engagement
Implementing, delivering, or planning implementation of anything
Generating delivery tickets or an implementation queue
Tracking errands or todos that are not decisions
preconditions: A human drives the map and is available for HITL tickets
An issue tracker exists: repo tracker doc, or a writable workspace for the fallback tracker
applicability.confidence_or_escalation_rule: Resume an existing applicable map rather than starting over. If inspection reveals one bounded design question, decline to chart and recommend /expanded-grill-with-docs; if it fits direct work, say so and return. Complexity alone never justifies a map. If the destination stays contested after its one gating question, charting waits on the human.

policy.primary_pattern: evidence-first breadth-mapping interview over tracker-backed decision-map orchestration
steps: Chart: resume or establish the map, settle the destination (infer-and-confirm or one gating question), inspect evidence, launch 0-6 bounded mapping scouts (default 2-4) inside the workflow, synthesize centrally, ask adaptive packets of 2-4 independently answerable questions, integrate answers, apply the fog-or-ticket test, create-then-wire dependencies, stop with a frontier and honest fog

Work cycle: load map and integrity-check, select from the frontier by impact and unblocking (not age), claim under this agent's worker identity (claimed_by, distinct from the human decision_owner) or resume one primary decision ticket, resolve by type with 1-3 question grilling rounds or the design handoff, record comment-close-index, integrate and reconcile, stop
Completion: assemble return_to_loop_router and hand back with an advisory recommendation
branches: Scouts: two or more only for independent surfaces; one or none when a single surface dominates; failures preserved as limitation, fog, research ticket, or blocking question — never fabricated
Packet sizing: one question when it gates the rest or the human asks for one-at-a-time; five only for exceptional independent breadth
Design tickets route through the /expanded-grill-with-docs handoff contract; a simple human choice never does; the fallback offers plain grilling explicitly
Research tickets: scout gathers, parent integrates, records, and closes
Repo tracker doc when provided; local-markdown fallback tracker otherwise
Oversized ticket: split per recovery reference; the split is the cycle's work
authoritative_sources: The repo's tracker doc when provided
The Loop Router for lifecycle selection

success_conditions: Chart mode: a queryable frontier another cycle can work from with only the map reference
Work cycle: exactly one primary decision ticket closed-and-indexed, split, superseded, or parked with progress commented and claim released, with the map reconciled
Map complete: destination mapped, sharp decisions resolved or deliberately deferred, no meaningful fog; return_to_loop_router assembled and handed back
failure_conditions: No tracker and the fallback cannot write
Destination cannot be settled after its gating question
HITL ticket with the human absent (park, do not fail silently)
stop_conditions: One primary decision ticket handled this cycle (supporting scouts and feeding research tickets excepted)
Charting complete without resolving anything; additional questions would not materially improve the map
Effort fits one bounded interview or direct work: no map; recommend the right capability
rollback_or_recovery: Fixed recording order comment-close-index makes crash recovery idempotent
Interrupted cycles resume from claims, progress comments, and linked packets
Integrity check plus repair order in references/recovery.md
Stale claims released only on the human's word
Material destination change closes the map with a successor pointer and charts fresh

inputs: loose idea or Loop Router handoff OR map reference plus optional ticket
the human driving the map (default decision_owner; worker claims recorded separately in claimed_by)
outputs: resumed or new map with typed wired tickets, honest fog, identified frontier
one primary ticket resolution per work cycle with integration effects
return_to_loop_router completion packet with advisory recommendation
artifacts: design documents produced by the expanded-grill child in repository-native locations
allowed_tools: tracker operations (issue create, edit, assign, close, comment) via the tracker's CLI or fallback file writes
Task for bounded scouts run inside the workflow
Write scoped to tracker artifacts and child-capability document scopes
side_effects: Creates and edits tracker issues and the map
Never writes implementation and never initiates a delivery lifecycle
